scope: Full requested multi-location PI/pharmacy platform including controlled substances, sterile/nonsterile compounding and AI assistance
method: Equal-weight gate completion: passed gates / all required gates. In-progress and blocked gates earn no partial credit. This is not code completion, effort elapsed, or a forecast. Every gate must pass; any blocker prevents launch.
update_policy: Update after meaningful verified milestones. A pass requires dated evidence and satisfaction of acceptance criteria. Record scope/denominator changes explicitly. This is a maintained evidence snapshot, not an automatic production monitor.

gates.title: Shared PI platform regression
gates.evidence: Tenant/role boundaries, financial history and record-only payment workflows have synthetic regression evidence.
gates.next_action: Retain this baseline when selecting the final release.
gates.acceptance: Synthetic request regressions pass; no production acceptance implied.

gates.title: Pharmacy foundation regression
gates.evidence: Intake, assigned locations, retained records, ordinary quantity accounting and documentary workflows pass synthetic regression.
gates.next_action: Carry this evidence into operational acceptance; restricted dispensing stays disabled.
gates.acceptance: Defined foundation tests pass; full operational scope is assessed separately below.

gates.title: Admin build and demonstrated journeys
gates.evidence: Optimized 120-page admin build passed; documented synthetic journeys and extraction-review save/read-back passed.
gates.next_action: Verify the selected release on real HTTPS origins and physical devices.
gates.acceptance: Build and documented local journeys pass; no claim that every clinical scenario is complete.

gates.title: Published baseline CI and release packages
gates.evidence: Published 914ae750 passed admin/backend/web CI, MySQL8/MariaDB10.11 synthetic upgrade/restore and source/Linux package verification.
gates.next_action: Keep archives pinned to their exact commit; they exclude uncommitted work.
gates.acceptance: A reproducible baseline exists; final-candidate readiness is a separate gate.

gates.title: Final candidate published and verified
gates.evidence: Extraction-attempt retention and pharmacist review remain uncommitted locally. Full local suite: 303 tests / 5811 assertions; final focused checks: 3 / 63.
gates.next_action: Finish review, publish the exact tree, pass current-head CI, refresh matching packages and dependency findings.
gates.acceptance: No pending release changes; exact final commit, checks and verified matching artifacts recorded.

gates.title: Authenticated host access and inventory
gates.evidence: No verified authenticated access. Sept29 SSH reached key exchange but stopped before authentication at unverified host identity.
gates.next_action: Administrator verifies host fingerprint and restores access; Codex inventories only authorized applications and existing ports.
gates.acceptance: Authenticated 144.126.132.98 identity, active roots, owners, runtimes and existing admin port verified.

gates.title: Production backup and demonstrated restore
gates.evidence: Panel backup existence and synthetic CI restores do not prove production recovery.
gates.next_action: Capture database, private files, keys and configuration; verify an authorized isolated restore without new ports.
gates.acceptance: Recoverable production snapshot and demonstrated coordinated restore with owner recorded.

gates.title: Production migration and runtime rehearsal
gates.evidence: MySQL/MariaDB synthetic checks pass; actual host schema, data and runtime compatibility remain unverified.
gates.next_action: Rehearse exact migrations and Linux artifacts against approved host-compatible conditions.
gates.acceptance: Actual schema compatibility, runtime support, upgrade and rollback evidence accepted.

gates.title: Production security and private storage
gates.evidence: Source protections exist; actual production configuration, grants and legacy document exposure remain unverified.
gates.next_action: Verify debug/cookies/CORS, least-privilege database access, private files and final dependency disposition.
gates.acceptance: Production configuration and private-file checks pass; material findings resolved or explicitly accepted.

gates.title: Production identity, MFA and recovery
gates.evidence: Synthetic authentication/recovery checks exist; owner-controlled production recovery and actual mail delivery remain unverified.
gates.next_action: Demonstrate administrator MFA and reset/invitation delivery or the accepted operator recovery path.
gates.acceptance: Owner can sign in and recover access; required account messages or agreed recovery procedures verified.

gates.title: Operational reliability and ownership
gates.evidence: Runbooks exist; production workers, scheduler, monitoring, outage and retention procedures are not accepted.
gates.next_action: Verify recovery, scheduled jobs, alert handling and named operational ownership.
gates.acceptance: Production operating checks and incident/retention/recovery ownership recorded.

gates.title: Cutover and real-origin role acceptance
gates.evidence: Redevelopment is not deployed; draft PR is unmerged. Existing public pages are not evidence of the new release.
gates.next_action: After prerequisites, cut over only three authorized applications; verify HTTPS journeys, all intended roles and rollback readiness.
gates.acceptance: Deployed commit/hashes recorded, real-origin acceptance passes and reopening writes is accepted.

gates.title: Operating scope, credentials and ordinary workflows
gates.evidence: Multiple locations and controlled/sterile/nonsterile scope are requested; actual site/staff credentials and operational acceptance remain absent.
gates.next_action: Identify pharmacist, actual locations/catalogue/workflows; close remaining ordinary prescription/correction/transfer and privacy incident requirements.
gates.acceptance: Named responsible pharmacist accepts supported scope, credentials and ordinary workflows; remaining gaps are resolved, not silently excluded.

gates.title: Clinical references and prescription receipt
gates.evidence: Manual review/source retention exists. Approved clinical reference data, prescriber authentication and prescribing connections remain unverified.
gates.next_action: Select supported providers/processes; implement and verify source/version, failure and override handling.
gates.acceptance: Supported receipt and clinical-check pathways pass pharmacist-reviewed end-to-end cases.

gates.title: Controlled dispensing and reporting
gates.evidence: Classification and correction records exist; final controlled dispensing is intentionally blocked.
gates.next_action: Finish schedule-specific quantity/refill/partial/expiry controls and required prescribing/reporting, acknowledgment, correction and outage handling.
gates.acceptance: Controlled workflow and reporting are verified end-to-end and professionally accepted before enablement.

gates.title: Compounding quality and finished-product release
gates.evidence: Formula, ingredients, worksheet, execution and audit records exist; output stays quarantined.
gates.next_action: Complete deviations, validated calculations, quality/BUD, sterile/nonsterile/hazardous procedures and finished-product release/traceability.
gates.acceptance: Actual supported preparation types and release pathways are validated and accepted.

gates.title: Inventory exceptions, custody and recall closure
gates.evidence: Synthetic counts, transfers, holds, recall tracing and dispositions exist; operational exceptions and physical procedures remain.
gates.next_action: Complete catalogue/unit conventions, transport/loss/excess/returns/destruction and recall outreach/closure acceptance.
gates.acceptance: Physical custody and exception cases reconcile with retained ledger and professional acceptance.

gates.title: Physical labels, scanning and handover
gates.evidence: Synthetic label/barcode/print records and handover evidence exist; physical device/output acceptance is outstanding.
gates.next_action: Verify actual printers/scanners, container labels, medication guides, reprints and delivery/recipient procedures.
gates.acceptance: Supported device and handover scenarios demonstrated and signed off by pharmacy operations.

gates.title: PIP payer transport and reconciliation
gates.evidence: Internal billing/coverage records exist; actual payer enrollment, transport/acknowledgments and reconciliation are unverified.
gates.next_action: Confirm target payers/transport, build missing submission/correction workflows, reconcile accepted test transactions.
gates.acceptance: Supported payer paths and corrected/reversed/reconciled outcomes verified; payments remain record-only.

gates.title: Approved AI/OCR integration and quality
gates.evidence: Manual transcription and source-linked draft/review infrastructure exists. GLM account, hosting and data terms are not confirmed; no provider is connected.
gates.next_action: Confirm approved processing; implement adapter and reviewed application of suggestions; validate extraction/OCR quality and failure cases.
gates.acceptance: Approved provider path and source-linked human-reviewed workflow tested; no autonomous clinical or dispensing authority.
